note: Barber County has no queryable zoning district service found in ArcGIS Online/Hub or county GIS pages. The county's own maps page offers only road, commissioner, school and taxing-unit PDFs. The largest city, Medicine Lodge, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (city zoning map and 3-mile zoning map). Kiowa publishes zone maps as images/PDF on its building and zoning page. No ArcGIS REST zoning layer exists for the county or these cities.
